theme: dotenv FSYNC durable env plate load gate CHMOD

tests.name: env_var_key_fix
tests.cmd: SYS ENV k with k=ROLE → value not empty

weaknesses.title: SYS ENV used IDENT text not string-var value (FIXED this iter)
weaknesses.detail: SYS ENV k with k="ROLE" looked up env key "k". Broke get/need/gate with ARG keys. Fixed: string vars + LAST; bare IDENT still env key token.
weaknesses.repro: pre-fix: LET k="ROLE"; ENV k → empty

weaknesses.title: DOTENV only mutates current process env
weaknesses.detail: Each cubalc run is a new process; load then get in separate invocations loses keys. Agents need gate (load+need same process) or re-load every run.
weaknesses.repro: run load; run get ROLE → empty pre-gate

weaknesses.title: DOTENV skip count opaque; no bag of loaded keys
weaknesses.detail: DOTENV_N/SKIP only. Agents cannot list which keys landed without DUMPENV filter.
weaknesses.repro: load n=3 skip=2 no key list

weaknesses.title: FSYNC after WRITEATOMIC still soft-miss if path races
weaknesses.detail: No combined WRITEATOMIC+FSYNC one-shot; multi-agent crash between write and fsync leaves unflushed plate.

weaknesses.title: ENV missing key returns OK=1 empty LAST
weaknesses.detail: Cannot distinguish miss from empty value without BLANK; OR fallback always OK=1.

weaknesses.title: 9BAD= and bare lines skip without per-line diagnostics
weaknesses.detail: DOTENV_SKIP aggregate only; hard to debug bad .env lines.

workarounds: Post-fix: ENV NAME with string NAME works
